title: CARSTEROIDS
description:
WELCOME TO THE CAR-COMBAT ARENA! 

Carsteroids is a fast, skill-based top-down shooter where armed vehicles battle across deadly asteroid arenas. 
Master your build, dodge incoming fire, and survive increasingly chaotic encounters.

GAME MODES:Story Mode• 15 randomly generated stages

• Upgrade your vehicle between fights

• Multiple endings and final bosses

Arcade Mode• 20-wave survival ladder

• Choose power-ups after each wave

• Face the giant Spider-Tank

Car-ball• 1v1 competitive mode

• Local multiplayer or CPU

• Score by forcing the ball into your opponent’s field

FEATURES:• 60 FPS responsive combat

• Random enemy encounters

• Multiple weapons & power-ups

• Couch co-op

• Steam achievements

• Gamepad support
description_short: Blast, drift and survive in fast-paced asteroid arenas where weaponized cars fight in a brutal space game show.
